Reasoning: Let the area of the large equilateral triangle be A. The problem gives that the side length of the inner triangle is 2/3 of the side length of the large triangle, so the area ratio is (2/3)^2 = 4/9; therefore the area of the inner triangle is 4A/9. The total area between the two triangles is A - 4A/9 = 5A/9. This region is divided into three congruent trapezoids, so the area of one trapezoid is (5A/9)/3 = 5A/27. Thus the ratio of the area of one trapezoid to the area of the inner triangle is (5A/27):(4A/9) = 5:12.
